item.description: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage , OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we're going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we're not going to need all the stuff in the data center. item.title: 2027: Rivers ADC seeks Ikwerre Elders’ support for Atiku, Amaechi
item.description: By Daniel Abia, Port Harcourt The Rivers State chapter of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) has met with leaders of the Ikwerre ethnic nationality to seek support for its presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, and his running mate, Chibuike Rotimi Amaechi, ahead of the 2027 general elections. The party’s leadership, led by its state chairman, Dr. Chukwudi Dimkpa, visited Ogbakor Ikwerre, the apex socio-cultural organisation of the Ikwerre people, to present its candidates and solicit the elders’ support. Dimkpa told the elders and community leaders that the party considered it important to present its candidates to them as respected statesmen and custodians of Ikwerre cultural heritage. He said an Atiku-Amaechi presidency would focus on moving the country forward, adding that the ADC chose the duo because of their experience and readiness to turn around the nation’s fortunes. The state chairman also used the opportunity to formally present the party’s governorship candidate, Dr. Gabriel Pidomson, his running mate, Mr. David Okumgba, as well as its senatorial, House of Representatives and State House of Assembly candidates of Ikwerre extraction, seeking the elders’ prayers and support. “The ADC as a party recognises Ogbakor Ikwerre as a foremost socio-cultural institution representing the identity, heritage and collective interests of the Ikwerre ethnic nationality,” he said. In his address, Pidomson reminded the elders of the significance of Amaechi’s vice-presidential candidacy, describing him as an illustrious son of Ikwerre who is running alongside Atiku on the ADC presidential ticket. He expressed hope that the Atiku-Amaechi ticket would emerge victorious in the 2027 presidential election, with Atiku becoming president and Amaechi vice-president. Pidomson described the prospect of an Ikwerre son occupying the nation’s second-highest political office as significant to the political history and national participation of the ethnic nationality. He also pledged inclusive governance if elected governor of Rivers State. “If I am elected Governor of Rivers State, I promise to be a governor for all Rivers people, irrespective of ethnic background, political affiliation or other differences. “We will build a new Rivers State that will reflect the collective aspirations of its people, with emphasis on inclusive governance, unity, development and the wellbeing of citizens,” he said. In his remarks, the ADC Deputy National Chairman and Chairman of the Rivers State Governorship Campaign Council, Senator Andrew Uchendu, commended Ogbakor Ikwerre for its contributions to the development and continued existence of Rivers State. Uchendu recalled the roles played by prominent personalities, including centenarian Prof. Otonti Nduka, Chief Samson Agbaru and Prof. Augustine Ahiazu, in the struggle for greater recognition, inclusion and political representation for the Ikwerre people. item.title: Brewers' Championship Caps Unique 2026 MLB Postseason
item.description: Milwaukee Brewers pitcher JoJo Romero The 2026 MLB playoffs are officially over, and for the first time ever, the Milwaukee Brewers are World Series champions. That isn't too surprising, however, as the Brewers had the best record in baseball this year and ended the season on fire . The World Series also capped a relatively drama-free playoffs where the team with the better regular-season record won every series -- the first time that's happened since MLB adopted its current playoff format in 2022. item.title: Pat Murphy takes brutal shot at Yankees while celebrating Brewers’ World Series Title with Jake Bauers
item.description: Pat Murphy guided the Milwaukee Brewers to their first World Series title, sealing the championship with a five-game win over the Tampa Bay Rays on Wednesday. Jake Bauers, who is approaching free agency, made valuable contributions throughout Milwaukee’s season. A postgame exchange between Murphy and Bauers caught attention, particularly after the manager delivered a pointed remark about the New York Yankees. Spectrum News 1 Wisconsin shared the moment. Jake Bauers gives Pat Murphy the last out ball. #Brewers #WorldSeries #WinOurWay #ThisIsMyCrew pic.twitter.com/E3pblrbzf8 — Spectrum News 1 Wisconsin (@SpectrumNews1WI) October 29, 2026 “Just remember, when you’re on that horses**t Yankees team and you guys are all playing for yourselves, just remember this is the way we used to do it,” the Brewers manager told Bauers. Jake Bauers with Pat Murphy and the Brewers Sep 20, 2025; St. Louis, Missouri, USA; Milwaukee Brewers left fielder Bauers (9) is congratulated by manager Pat Murphy (49) after scoring against the St. Louis Cardinals during the second inning at Busch Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jeff Curry-Imagn Images Players who establish their value with smaller-market clubs often attract lucrative offers from larger franchises once they reach free agency. Bauers may soon find himself in that position, with the Yankees potentially among his suitors. Should New York pursue him, Murphy’s remarks after the Brewers’ championship celebration could make the first baseman reconsider whether joining the Bronx club is the right move. Sep 20, 2026; Baltimore, Maryland, USA; Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy looks on prior to the game between the Baltimore Orioles and the Milwaukee Brewers Oriole Park at Camden Yards. Mandatory Credit: James A. Pittman-Imagn Images Bauers put together a strong regular season, batting .266 with an .874 OPS and 26 homers. He carried that production into the playoffs, e arning NLCS MVP honors followed by an inconsistent showing in the World Series. His performance across the season has given the left-handed hitter a strong case to test the free-agent market and pursue a sizable deal. After playing such a key role in Milwaukee’s championship run, Bauers could remain part of the Brewers’ plans. Whether the team will make a serious effort to bring him back is now one of the questions surrounding his upcoming free agency. item.title: Staples girls basketball coach arrested after police say he choked referee during game over foul call
item.description: Thomas Sparks was arrested after police say he choked a basketball referee during a youth game in Shelton on Oct. 24, 2026. (Courtesy of Shelton Police Department ) The Staples High School girls basketball coach has resigned after being arrested for allegedly tripping and choking a referee over a disputed call during a youth game in Shelton last week, officials said. Thomas Sparks, 37, was arrested Oct. 24 and charged with third-degree assault, second-degree strangulation and risk of injury to a child after a referee at a youth basketball game at the Boys and Girls Club in Shelton filed a complaint, a police report said. Sparks resigned Thursday as Staples girls basketball coach. "Tommy resigned for personal and family considerations," Staples High School Athletic Director said in a text message on Friday. Sparks was coaching a team for the Connecticut Elite youth basketball league on Oct. 24 when he confronted the referee about what he perceived to be a bad foul call, the police report said. Officials at Connecticut Elite declined to discuss the incident on Friday, but said Sparks no longer worked for them. During a verbal exchange, the referee told police Sparks called him a "dickhead," and then seconds later tripped and shoved him to the ground, according to the report. Before the referee could get up, Sparks put his arm around the man's neck at which point others in the crowd stepped in to intervene, the police report said. Sparks was ejected from the building and the referee later showed up at the police station to file a report. He told police that he felt like he might pass out while Sparks had his arm was around his neck, the report said. Sparks told police that he took physical action because he didn't know what the referee would do after their verbal exchange, the report said. Witnesses, including some of the players, confirmed the referee's version of events, police said. Sparks was released on $10,000 bond and is due back in court Nov. 12. item.title: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava Makes Major 2027 NFL Draft Decision After Season-Ending ACL Injury
item.description: UCLA Bruins has received clarity on its quarterback plans after Nico Iamaleava decided to remain with the program. His return follows a shortened 2026 campaign that ended with a knee injury. Iamaleava’s decision comes after helping the Bruins win their first five games. His agent confirmed the decision, and the quarterback later addressed his future in an Instagram post. UCLA QB plans to remain with the Bruins UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava plans to return to the Bruins for the 2027 season instead of entering the 2027 NFL Draft. His agent confirmed the decision to On3 reporter Pete Nakos. Iamaleava will return to UCLA after a torn ACL ended his 2026 season. Oct 10, 2026; Eugene, Oregon, USA; UCLA Bruins quarterback Nico Iamaleava (9) drops back for a pass during the first quarter against the Oregon Ducks at Autzen Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Troy Wayrynen-Imagn Images The announcement read: “NEW: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava has informed the Bruins he plans to return next season, his agent tells @PeteNakos ” Iamaleava previously played two seasons with the Tennessee Volunteers before joining UCLA in 2025. He became the Bruins’ starting quarterback and recorded 1,928 passing yards, 12 touchdowns and seven interceptions in his first season with the program. He started the 2026 season with five consecutive wins. In those games, Iamaleava completed 72 of 116 passes for 982 yards, four touchdowns and four interceptions. He also recorded 144 rushing yards and one rushing touchdown as UCLA improved to 5-0. His season ended on October 10 against Oregon after he suffered a torn ACL. He left the game and was ruled out for the remainder of the 2026 season. Ty Dieffenbach took over at quarterback following Iamaleava’s injury. He helped UCLA secure a 17-15 victory over Oregon before leading the team to wins against Wisconsin and Michigan State. Across those three games, Dieffenbach recorded 505 passing yards, two touchdowns and one interception. UCLA improved to 7-0 following those three victories. After the injury, Iamaleava addressed his season-ending setback in an Instagram post. He expressed his disappointment and shared his plans to return to football. He wrote : “Well, I’m heartbroken the way my season ended. I’ve finally accepted that this year is really over for me. This wasn’t a part of the plan, but I believe everything happens for a reason. I gave this game and my brothers everything I had and I’ll continue to lean on God and trust His plan. I’ll be back.” The confirmation followed Iamaleava’s social media message after the injury. Iamaleava will rejoin UCLA’s quarterback competition alongside Dieffenbach, who also has remaining college eligibility. Dieffenbach’s performances during Iamaleava’s absence have given the Bruins another option at the position. Both quarterbacks remain part of UCLA’s plans entering the 2027 season. item.title: Jeffery Simmons’ Arrival Has Experts High on Bears’ Super Bowl Chances
item.description: The Chicago Bears acquired defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons from the Tennessee Titans. The trade gives Chicago a star defender ahead of the deadline. ESPN analyst Field Yates praised the move. He noted that adding Jeffery Simmons immediately makes the Chicago Bears serious Super Bowl contenders. Bears’ blockbuster move for Jeffery Simmons fuels championship talk The Bears sent 2027 and 2028 first-round picks to Tennessee. They also included a 2027 fourth-round pick. Chicago received Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick. The trade fills a major need for Chicago. It gives the team a proven leader on the defensive line. This helps their playoff push. Dec 7, 2025; Cleveland, Ohio, USA; Tennessee Titans defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons (98) reacts after sacking Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders (not pictured) during the fourth quarter at Huntington Bank Field. Mandatory Credit: Scott Galvin-Imagn Images Field Yates stated , “The Bears look like a team good enough to be hoisting a Lombardi trophy.” Simmons is coming off his first first-team All-Pro season in 2025. He had a career-high 11 sacks that year. Simmons remained a dominant force on the interior defensive line this season, consistently disrupting opposing backfields before the trade. Simmons spent his entire career with the Titans until this trade. He is 29 years old and was selected 19th overall by the Titans in the 2019 NFL Draft. The move gives Chicago a proven interior defender. Entering the 2026 NFL season, the defensive tackle was playing under a three-year, $105.8 million contract extension with $100 million guaranteed, averaging $35.27 million per year. The Bears will take on that contract as they pursue a Super Bowl run. The front office has officially signaled an all-in approach for the current campaign . Tennessee received two first-round picks and a fourth-round pick. The deal gives the Titans draft capital for a rebuild. Simmons fills a major need for Chicago’s interior pass rush, which has struggled to generate consistent pressure from the defensive tackles this season. His arrival immediately upgrades the front seven. Titans general manager Ran Carthon said Simmons was an elite player on and off the field. The Titans announced the trade Thursday, and the Bears made it official shortly after. The Bears had been noted as a potential aggressive buyer before the deadline. Chicago previously acquired pass rusher Montez Sweat in a similar midseason trade during the 2023 season. The front office has signaled an all-in approach for the current campaign. item.title: Hornets’ 25 Turnovers Killed Game Against Pistons On Wednesday
item.description: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images The Charlotte Hornets need to fix their ball-handling issues immediately. The loss to the Detroit Pistons on Wednesday night showed exactly what happens when the team turns the ball over too much. Cade Cunningham scored 30 points to lead Detroit to a 97-89 win. The Hornets simply could not stop the bleeding with their mistakes. It was a tough night for a young squad that needs to learn how to protect the rock. Turnovers Cost Charlotte Everything The numbers tell a clear story about why the Hornets lost. Charlotte turned the ball over 25 times while Detroit only had 14. That is a huge gap that no team can overcome easily. The Pistons forced eight turnovers in the third quarter alone. This surge helped Detroit start the period with a 16-5 run. The Hornets had built a lead earlier but could not hold it. The lack of ball security was the main reason the game slipped away. Brandon Miller tried to keep the team in the hunt. He finished with 31 points and 12 rebounds for Charlotte. But his shooting struggles in the final period hurt the chances of a comeback. In the fourth quarter, Miller missed five out of his seven shots. Dennis Schroeder added 14 points but no other player reached double figures. The team needs more scoring depth if they want to win close games. Second Quarter Struggles Defined the Loss Charlotte looked good in the first half. The Hornets held a 51-44 lead at the break thanks to Miller’s 21 points. Neither team could hit shots consistently during the game. The Hornets did manage to grab six more second-chance points than Detroit. That small edge kept them ahead for a while. But the Pistons started the third quarter with a massive run that changed the flow. Four different Detroit players hit 3-pointers during that stretch. The Pistons are now 4-1 on the season. They came off a big loss to New York on Tuesday but bounced back quickly. The Hornets need to figure out how to stop these runs. A team cannot win if they give up easy baskets and turn the ball over repeatedly. The loss to Detroit on Wednesday night is a clear warning. The young players must learn to handle the pressure better. The Hornets will need to fix their defense and ball movement fast. The Pistons showed that they can score from anywhere on the floor. Charlotte cannot afford to play this sloppy again. The team must cut down on those 25 turnovers in the next game.

item.title: Lake Norman volleyball player shares bond with coach through cancer battle
item.description: One Huntersville high school is celebrating its champions -- Lake Norman Charter High School’s varsity volleyball team just took the state title for the second year in a row on Friday. Channel 9’s Elsa Gillis met with the team before their championship game and learned the team is no stranger to fighting tough battles on and off the court. “Oh my gosh! So I’ve known Coach Zoey ... she’s awesome,” Avery Caruso told Channel 9. Avery Caruso lights up when she talks about her volleyball coach, Zoey Reid. “She always helps like inspire us when we’re in our huddles. She always knows what to say,” Avery said. The feeling is mutual. “I like to call it a God-winked moment that I got to coach Avery,” Zoey said. Avery is a freshman, but plays varsity volleyball at Lake Norman Charter High School. She and her assistant coach share an unlikely bond off the court. “I remember basically everything, so it was really hard,” Avery said. Avery is a childhood cancer survivor. She was diagnosed with leukemia at age 9. She’s now in remission and celebrating a big milestone. “Today is the day that I rang the bell four years ago,” Avery said. But Coach Zoey is in the thick of her own battle. “My senior year of college, I was diagnosed with stage four rhabdomyosarcoma, which is a soft tissue muscle cancer, and it’s very, very, very rare,” Zoey said. She overcame it once. But last summer, she relapsed, just after getting the job as the head middle school and assistant varsity coach. “I’m like, wait, I can’t go through all this intensive treatment. I’ve literally just got this job, and I’m coaching these little girls, and they need me,” Zoey said. But through the treatment, she continues to show up. “She’s such a fighter,” Avery said. As they do for her. “If I couldn’t speak because I was doing treatment that day, or if I couldn’t coach or I couldn’t go out there and give it my all, those girls didn’t mind. They were still there in my corner no matter what, making sure. ‘Hey, coach, do you need a fan or do you need some water?’” Zoey said. “It’s, I get to go to volleyball today. I don’t ‘have,’ it’s not ‘have.’ It’s like I ‘get’ to, because there’s somebody laying in a hospital bed right now, wishing they had the opportunity that I had to just wake up and walk and go to school and go and teach or do anything,” Zoey said. Together, they’re learning what it really takes to be a champion on and off the court.

item.title: Thunder reportedly sign ex-Raptors former first-rounder amid Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace injuries
item.description: Thunder reportedly sign ex-Raptors former first-rounder amid Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace injuries originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Oklahoma City Thunder have been one of the best teams in the NBA over the last two seasons, and it doesn't look like that will change this season either. However, even though the season has only been underway for a little over a week, the team has already suffered some significant injuries. Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace recently suffered injuries, and it was announced earlier in the week that both could potentially miss the remainder of the season. “The Oklahoma City Thunder lost two starters to long-term injuries in their 108-101 win over the LA Clippers on Sunday night. General manager Sam Presti announced Monday that guard Jalen Williams will undergo surgery for a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, while guard Cason Wallace will undergo surgery for a torn labrum in his left shoulder. Both players are expected to miss several months,” ESPN wrote. On Monday, Thunder general manager Sam Presti met with the media to discuss the injuries. When asked about potential roster additions, he didn't have an answer just yet. “I haven't thought about anything relative to the roster spot,” Presti said. “I understand the question. But all I'm really focused on right now is players, giving them the right support and then helping everybody in our group realize that we have a tremendous challenge in front of us.” A few days later, it looks like Presti has a better idea of which direction he wants to go in the backcourt. The Thunder are signing former first-round pick Ochai Agbaji, who played college basketball at Kansas. “The Oklahoma City Thunder plan to sign Ochai Agbaji, league sources told hoopshype. Agbaji has averaged 7.2 points in four NBA seasons with the Utah Jazz , Toronto Raptors , and Brooklyn Nets . Agbaji was most recently with the New York Knicks in training camp,” HoopsHype’s Michael Scott wrote. Adding Agbaji gives OKC another option for its backcourt and provides some much-needed depth. The Thunder are typically smart about the players they add to their roster, so they clearly see something in the former Toronto Raptors guard. There are several ways Agbaji could impact a game for OKC. This is a real opportunity for him to prove that he still belongs in the NBA after being cut by the New York Knicks during the preseason. item.title: Dak Prescott Issues Blunt Mandate to Cowboys Squad Following 3-4 Start to Season
item.description: Dak Prescott has put the Dallas Cowboys on notice after a rough start at home. The Cowboys are 3-4 after losing three of four games at AT&T Stadium. Prescott urged his teammates to protect home turf ahead of the Arizona Cardinals game. Dallas found balance in a win over Philadelphia, rushing for 204 yards. The team also produced more than 200 passing yards. Prescott now wants that level of play to continue at home. Dak Prescott sets high standards for Cowboys squad Prescott’s message followed a 24-16 loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Dallas struggled to stop the run in that game. Bucky Irving finished with 165 rushing yards, including a 72-yard run to open the second half. Oct 26, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott (4) calls a playb during the fourth quarter against the Philadelphia Eagles at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images “Even more so important to come back and come back home and to get a win after the last time being here at home. And yeah, you’ve got to win your games at home. That’s a huge advantage,” Prescott said . The loss was compounded by self-inflicted mistakes, including missed tackles, explosive plays allowed, and a costly kickoff fumble by KaVontae Turpin. That turnover helped Tampa Bay create a 14-point advantage. Jerry Jones called the performance “extraordinarily, extraordinarily disappointing,” a frustration heightened by the Buccaneers entering the matchup winless. Prescott echoed that sentiment, clarifying that Dallas simply failed to control a game they were fully expected to win. Arizona presents a different challenge despite its 2-5 record. The Cardinals have consistently caused problems for Dallas in recent seasons, including a tough 28-16 loss in Arizona last year. They enter this matchup having won all four of their previous games at AT&T Stadium. Their recent record against the Cowboys makes it difficult to treat this as a routine home game. Dallas will also need to prove that the improvement against Philadelphia was more than a one-week response. The Cowboys had scored only 29 points across the two games before the Eagles matchup. Against Arizona, they must maintain their commitment to the running game while protecting Prescott from pressure. The Cardinals are expected to test Dallas with more blitz looks, an area that caused problems for the Cowboys earlier in the season. Prescott said the offense has prepared for those situations, but the adjustments will have to work under game pressure. For Dallas, the formula is straightforward. The Cowboys must run the ball efficiently and avoid turnovers. They must also prevent Arizona from producing explosive plays. A win would move the Cowboys to 4-4 and give them their first back-to-back victories of the season. Another home loss, however, would raise serious questions about their ability to compete consistently in the NFC East. More NFL News Los Angeles Rams Announce Matthew Stafford Milestone

item.title: USC football’s shaky season comes down to pulling massive upset or bust
item.description: It’s Lincoln Riley’s Last Stand, and USC football fans don’t need to chug the contents of multiple beer swords to make a case for the Trojans holding firm. Among the many theories as to why they could upset second-ranked Ohio State: The Buckeyes will start either a true freshman or a redshirt freshman at quarterback after Julian Sayin suffered a severe shoulder injury. Southern California head coach Lincoln Riley, left, talks with quarterback Jayden Maiava (14) against Penn State on Oct. 10, 2026, in State College, Pa. AP Photo/Barry Reeger The game is at the Coliseum, where Riley has gone 26-6. Ohio State is favored by just 6.5 points, meaning even Las Vegas thinks the Trojans have a decent chance. Then again, maybe a few cold ones might be in order given the counterpoints. It doesn’t really matter who plays quarterback for Ohio State given the presence of wide receiver Jeremiah Smith, who turns 50-50 balls into something closer to 90-10 in his favor. Buckeyes coach Ryan Day is a road winner, having notched 30 victories on the road since the start of the 2019 season to tie for the most in the country. Ohio State’s defense is giving up 13.4 points per game, putting an extra onus on the Trojans’ defense to be equally stout. Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith leaves the field after an NCAA football game against Indiana at Memorial Stadium in Bloomington, Ind., Oct. 17, 2026. A loss would likely erode all remaining support. With three losses, USC would be eliminated from CFP contention with three games left — including two against top-10 teams. That might be the tipping point for those on the fence about paying Riley’s massive buyout in what’s supposed to be a make-or-break season. Wisconsin linebacker Cooper Catalano tackles USC running back King Miller during a game at Camp Randall Stadium in Madison, Wis., Oct. 24, 2026. One option is Luke Fahey, a true freshman who played against Indiana after Sayin went down — and threw only two passes as the Buckeyes protected a late lead. item.title: Lagos warns residents of impending extreme heat
item.description: By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos State Government has warned residents to prepare for possible extreme heat and associated environmental and public health challenges as climate outlooks indicate rising temperatures across parts of Africa, including Nigeria. The Commissioner for the Environment and Water Resources, Tokunbo Wahab, gave the advisory on Friday, urging residents to take preventive measures to protect their health and wellbeing. Wahab said the strengthening El Niño climate pattern, alongside the seasonal transition into the dry season, could contribute to unusual temperature conditions, increased heat discomfort, dry spells, dust and deteriorating air quality. He noted that although the intensity and local impact would depend on prevailing weather patterns, residents should take the emerging climate risks seriously. According to him, Lagos, as a densely populated and rapidly urbanising coastal city, could face heightened exposure to extreme heat. “The concentration of buildings, roads and other heat-absorbing infrastructure, coupled with limited green spaces and inadequate ventilation in some neighbourhoods, could intensify temperatures in built-up areas,” he said. Wahab warned that prolonged exposure to excessive heat could lead to dehydration, heat exhaustion and heatstroke, with potentially serious consequences. He identified children, older persons, pregnant women, outdoor workers, street traders, construction workers, waste handlers and people with underlying health conditions as particularly vulnerable. The commissioner urged families, employers, schools and community leaders to pay special attention to these groups and ensure that protective measures were put in place. He also cautioned that extreme heat could worsen air-quality challenges during the dry season, when dust and haze increase respiratory irritation. He added that increased reliance on petrol and diesel-powered generators during power interruptions could further worsen local air pollution. Wahab urged residents to avoid open burning of refuse and adopt environmentally responsible practices. He advised residents to drink sufficient water regularly, wear lightweight and breathable clothing, seek shade and well-ventilated spaces, and reduce strenuous outdoor activities during the hottest periods of the day. He also encouraged schools, markets, workplaces and other public facilities to provide adequate ventilation, access to drinking water and shaded areas. The commissioner urged residents to watch out for warning signs of heat-related illnesses, including excessive sweating, dizziness, headache, weakness, nausea and muscle cramps. “Anyone experiencing these symptoms should be moved to a cooler environment, given appropriate cooling assistance and taken for medical attention where necessary. “Sudden collapse or loss of consciousness should be treated as medical emergencies requiring immediate attention. “Residents with respiratory conditions are also advised to limit expo

item.title: Beachside volleyball year ends in tiebreaker controversy. What happened?
item.description: Beachside volleyball coaches and fans are voicing their frustration after the Florida High School Athletic Association's tiebreaker formula excluded the Barracudas from the final four of the inaugural Open Division in spite of their Oct. 28 victory against Naples First Baptist. Instead, Clearwater Calvary Christian and Tampa Plant emerged as the two teams from Pool B for the semifinals in Winter Haven. Both schools, along with Beachside, finished with identical 2-1 records in the round-robin format, which also included First Baptist (0-3). How did it happen? Watch Florida high school volleyball live on NFHS Network What is the FHSAA volleyball Open Division? In June 2026, the FHSAA board of directors voted to implement the Open Division — an eight-team super tournament with the eight highest-ranked teams statewide following the district tournaments — for team sports statewide beginning in the 2026-27 school year. The board had announced Open Division plans in June 2024 , but scheduled a two-year preparation period before actually activating the new division. At the end of the district tournaments, the FHSAA pulls the eight highest-ranked teams out of their respective regional tournaments (the next-highest ranked teams in those regions take their place) and assigns them to the Open Division. The Open Division then holds its matches on the same dates as the standard regional tournaments. How is the FHSAA Open Division structured? The FHSAA's Open Division divides those eight teams into two groups of four, Pool A and Pool B. Pool A contains the teams ranked first, fourth, fifth and eighth in the FHSAA ranking system, while Pool B contains the teams ranked second, third, sixth and seventh. As the sixth-ranked team in the FHSAA's formula after the district tournaments, Beachside was placed in Pool B alongside Calvary Christian (No. 2), Plant (No. 3) and First Baptist (No. 7). Under FHSAA rules, the top two finishers in each group advance to the semifinals in Winter Haven, where the Pool A winner meets the Pool B runner-up and the Pool B winner competes against the Pool A runner-up. What happened in the FHSAA Pool B matches? Beachside, Calvary Christian and Plant all defeated First Baptist, but their own matches were deadlocked. Beachside defeated Calvary Christian on Oct. 21, Plant defeated Beachside on Oct. 24 and Calvary Christian defeated Plant on Oct. 28. That left those three teams tied at 2-1, with only the top two advancing to the state semifinals. What are the FHSAA tiebreaker procedures for volleyball? Here, the situation became even more complicated. In June, when the FHSAA formally approved the Open Division, the association listed its primary three-team tiebreaker as points allowed among tied teams only . This was the same tiebreaker the FHSAA installed for other team sports such as basketball and soccer, but its use in volleyball drew criticism from multiple coaches. item.title: NBA Fans Are Asking Questions After Naz Reid Gets Shockingly Benched by Hornets
item.description: Photo by: Lon Horwedel The Charlotte Hornets made a surprising decision Wednesday night, and it has quickly become one of the biggest talking points surrounding the team. Naz Reid, one of Charlotte’s biggest offseason additions, was unexpectedly benched for the entire second half of the team’s 97-89 loss to the Detroit Pistons. What makes the situation even more interesting is that Reid wasn’t dealing with an injury. Instead, head coach Charles Lee decided he had seen enough during the first half and kept the veteran forward on the bench for the remainder of the game. What Happened Between Reid and the Coaching Staff? Reid finished the first half with seven points, six rebounds and one block in 13 minutes. However, something apparently happened that led Lee to make the surprising decision. After the game, Lee addressed the situation but didn’t provide many details. “Unfortunately, Naz didn’t meet our standards in the first half,” Lee explained. He added that the team made the decision at halftime that Reid would not play again. The coach did not clarify exactly which standards Reid failed to meet, leaving fans searching for answers. Footage from the first half also raised questions. Reid appeared to have a confusing exchange involving offensive play signals before a sequence that ended with another difficult possession. Some observers have speculated that communication and execution may have played a role, but the exact reason remains unconfirmed. A Strange Decision That Cost Charlotte The timing made the decision even more surprising. Charlotte actually entered halftime leading Detroit 51-44, but the Pistons completely took control after the break. Detroit outscored the Hornets 53-38 in the second half, eventually securing an eight-point victory. Reid had been playing well to begin his Charlotte career, averaging 19.5 points and 9.5 rebounds through his first four games. What Happens Next? The good news for Charlotte fans is that reports indicate Reid and Lee cleared the air following the game. Reid is expected to move forward with the team rather than allowing the situation to become a bigger distraction. Still, benching one of your most important players for an entire half is a major statement. Was Lee sending a message, or is there more to this situation than fans know?

item.title: Leclerc fastest in Mexico City Grand Prix first practice
item.description: Charles Leclerc went fastest in a practice session featuring 10 rookie drivers [Reuters] Ferrari's Charles Leclerc led Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli in first practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix, where the Italian is poised to clinch his first world title. Leclerc was 0.659 seconds quicker than Antonelli, for whom a ninth-place finish will secure the championship regardless of any other results. Only a victory by his team-mate George Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton can theoretically stop Antonelli becoming champion on Sunday. Even then, Antonelli only needs ninth place if Russell wins and 10th if Hamilton does. Third quickest in the session was Mercedes reserve Frederik Vesti, driving Russell's car, ahead of Hamilton. Mercedes were one of 10 teams to choose this session to do one of their mandatory rookie sessions. Only Ferrari had both race drivers in their cars. Mexico City is chosen by many teams to run their mandatory rookie sessions because the first session is traditionally unrepresentative as a result of the dirty track surface. Japanese Ayumu Iwasa, in for Max Verstappen at Red Bull, was fifth fastest, ahead of Alpine's Pierre Gasly and Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso. McLaren's Oscar Piastri, Haas driver Oliver Bearman and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad completed the top 10. Briton Freddie Slater's first outing at a grand prix weekend for Audi did not go to plan. Reliability problems limited his running to 14 laps - about half a standard mileage. But he did manage to get out for the final 20 minutes or so and set the 19th fastest time. He was just behind another Briton, Luke Browning having his latest run in the Williams. American Colton Herta, who Cadillac are considering promoting to F1 next year in place of Valtteri Bottas, was 22nd. Governing body the FIA says Herta, a nine-time winner in Indycar, has now done enough miles to score the 40 points he needs to secure the superlicence required to race in F1. item.title: Hugo González, Baylor Scheierman extend tenure with Boston Celtics
item.description: Saturday, Oct. 31, marked an important day for Boston Celtics wings Baylor Scheierman and Hugo González. It was the deadline for the Green Team to make a decision on the club options for the aforementioned C's. There was no spooky contract drama on Halloween night, though, as the Celtics picked up both 2027-28 rookie scale options on Friday afternoon, per Keith Smith of Spotrac . These two moves will fully guarantee Scheierman and González's money for next season and, barring a trade or another unforeseen maneuver, keep them in the green and white until 2028 at the very least. Following the 2027-28 campaign, González will encounter a club option once again while Scheierman will become a restricted free agent — unless he's extended next summer. Boston's backup wings have put together a relatively slow start to the season. González logged 0 points in his first two outings before scorching the Chicago Bulls on Monday night with 13 points on almost 67 percent shooting during a 134-99 victory. Scheierman has been even quieter. He's yet to score in double figures but has averaged a little over 17 minutes per game thus far. Through four contests, the Celtics hold a 3-1 record and hover around the top of the Eastern Conference standings. They could tie the 4-1 Detroit Pistons and 4-1 Philadelphia 76ers with a win on Friday night versus the Bulls at TD Garden. Although 26-year-old Scheierman and 20-year-old González haven't wowed to open up the regular season, they provide the Celtics with crucial depth and should be called upon more in November. item.title: FG assures ECOWAS of peaceful 2027 elections
item.description: By Favour Ulebor, Abuja The Federal Government has assured the Economic Community of West African States, ECOWAS, of its commitment to conducting peaceful, credible, transparent and inclusive general elections in 2027. In a statement on Friday, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu, gave the assurance during a meeting with the ECOWAS Pre-Election Fact-Finding Mission to Nigeria, led by former Vice-President of Sierra Leone, Victor Bockarie Foh, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Abuja. Odumegwu-Ojukwu said the Federal Government was committed to ensuring that the electoral process complied with the provisions of the Nigerian Constitution and relevant electoral laws. She described the 2027 general elections as a defining moment for Nigeria’s democracy, expressing optimism that the process would strengthen democratic governance in the country and the West African sub-region. The minister said institutional preparedness, transparent voter accreditation, effective management of election results and timely resolution of electoral disputes were important to building public confidence in the electoral system. She also stressed the need for effective coordination among security agencies to protect candidates, electoral officials, observers and voters before, during and after the elections. According to her, security personnel must perform their duties professionally and impartially while respecting the country’s human rights obligations. The minister further highlighted the importance of voter education and effective enforcement of electoral laws, noting that political parties, civil society organisations, traditional institutions and the media had important roles to play in ensuring peaceful elections. She expressed concern over the dangers of misinformation and disinformation, calling for accurate, accessible and timely information on the electoral process. Odumegwu-Ojukwu also identified the need to improve measures that would encourage the participation of persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups in the elections. Earlier, Foh said the mission was in Nigeria to assess the country’s preparedness for the 2027 general elections through consultations with relevant institutions and stakeholders. He said the mission had engaged the Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, political parties, security agencies, civil society organisations and the media. Foh disclosed that its earlier engagements with stakeholders, including the Inter-Party Advisory Council, the Nigerian Civil Society Situation Room and the Nigerian Union of Journalists, had been constructive. He said the mission’s preliminary assessment suggested a favourable environment for the forthcoming elections, adding, however, that consultations were still ongoing. According to him, the mission would submit a report outlining its findings and recommendations at the end of the exercise. The former Sierra Leonean vice-president welcomed the assurance

item.title: Cause of death determined for college football player after ‘traumatic injury’ in game
item.description: A pile of footballs sit before a high school football game in South Bend, Ind. Southern Nazarene University safety Tyler Ulrich died earlier this month from injuries he suffered during a game, and the school has said little about what exactly happened. Now, more details about his death have come to light. According to a coroner’s report, Ulrich, 21, suffered a traumatic brain injury and a brain bleed after a helmet-to-helmet hit during a game against Ouachita Baptist University. He was hospitalized on Oct. 10 and died five days later. Injured During Game Ulrich, a redshirt sophomore from Azle, Texas, was one of the top tacklers for Southern Nazarene, a Division II program in Bethany, Oklahoma. He was injured while involved in a group tackle during the team’s 49-14 loss at Ouachita Baptist in Arkansas, according to head coach Dustin Hada. Paramedics attended to Ulrich on the field for nearly an hour before he was taken to a nearby hospital. On Oct. 15, the school announced that he had died from what it called a “traumatic injury” , but it did not reveal the cause of death or the nature of the injury. Southern Nazarene finished the game against Ouachita Baptist but canceled its game the following week. The team returned to the field last Saturday, beating Northwestern Oklahoma State 60-37. The school’s president, football team, and coaches also attended a Celebration of Life service for Ulrich last Sunday in Azle. ‘Helmet To Helmet’ The Garland County Coroner’s Office report said that Ulrich was “hit helmet to helmet causing the subdural hematoma,” according to ESPN’s Dan Murphy , who obtained the report. A university spokesperson told ESPN on Friday that the school had not yet received the coroner’s report. Ulrich’s family did not respond to ESPN’s attempt to reach them. Dave Myrick, the team’s radio play-by-play announcer, said that nothing about the hit initially stood out to him. “There was nothing in the run of that play that made you go, ‘Oh man, that looked horrible,'” Myrick said. “Just a normal football play.” That changed once he saw how Ulrich’s teammates reacted. “And while I’m saying we got a player down, I see our players’ reaction to what they see, and that is when it kind of changed the tide, you know, in my tone,” Myrick added. “They were jumping up and down yelling for our medical staff to come on the field.” Myrick said that the medical staff was quickly joined by a county sheriff and Ulrich’s mother. ‘A Tremendous Man of Faith’ According to data collected by the National Center for Catastrophic Sport Injury Research, Ulrich is one of two football players to die from a traumatic head or neck injury during a game in the past nine years. He is also the second college football player to die this season due to a game-related incident. William Jewell College running back MicahJo Barnett collapsed on his team’s sideline during a game in early August, though the school did not disclose his cause of death. item.title: FIA hands out first grid penalty of the weekend in Mexico City
item.description: Cadillac 's Valtteri Bottas is set to start the Mexico City Grand Prix from the back of the grid on Sunday afternoon. The first grid penalty has already been handed out at the Mexico City Grand Prix. Several power unit components have been changed in the Finnish driver's Cadillac, including the internal combustion engine, turbocharger, energy store, control electronics unit and MGU-K. These component changes add up to a 50-place grid penalty for the Finn, which means he will start Sunday's race from the back of the grid. Bottas is yet complete a single lap today as of now. During the first free practice session, he handed over his car to Colton Herta. Photo: Race Pictures Photo: Race Pictures Leclerc and Ferrari set the pace in FP1 in Mexico City Charles Leclerc topped the opening session of the weekend in Mexico. The Monegasque driver finished ahead of Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Frederik Vesti. Moreover, his lap time was around two tenths of a second quicker than the fastest time recorded in FP1 during the 2025 season. However, the final results are not the most representative in terms of the pecking order this weekend, as Max Verstappen, Lando Norris and George Russell, among others, did not participate in the session. Audi under investigation by the FIA stewards Stewards have also launched their first investigation of the Grand Prix weekend after Audi sent Freddie Slater out onto the track with a fan still attached to his car. A team representative was summoned to appear before the stewards at 14:00 local time (20:00 UK time).

There will also be NBA Cup games on Tuesday, Nov. 24 and Wednesday, Nov. 25. How does the NBA Cup work? The league's 30 teams were separated into six groups featuring five teams in August. The NBA determined the groups using a draw system that placed each team in a pod based on their record during the 2025-26 season. item.title: Jack Nicklaus predicted Bryson DeChambeau would pull off never seen before feat during the 2020 Masters
item.description: Photo by Sam Greenwood/Getty Images Jack Nicklaus is not one for hyperbole. So the prediction he made about Bryson DeChambeau back in 2020 really did raise some eyebrows. Nicklaus is the greatest golfer of all time, certainly if we take major wins as the main barometer. The Golden Bear won 18 major championships throughout his career, including six wins at The Masters. Jack Nicklaus knows Augusta National like the back of his hand, and his knowledge of the golf course played a key role in his record of six Masters titles. Meanwhile, Bryson DeChambeau has won two majors, although he is still yet to earn himself a green jacket. With his skillset, he will surely win The Masters one day. His length off the tee and shot shape from right to left make his game tailor-made for Augusta National. Speaking of his prodigious speed and power, Nicklaus believed that the LIV Golf star’s length off the tee would enable him to overpower Augusta back in 2020. The prediction Jack Nicklaus made about Bryson DeChambeau in 2020 Nicklaus spoke to Golf.com about DeChambeau ahead of The Masters in 2020. Due to Covid, The Masters was not played until November of that year, and due to the firm and fast conditions, the Golden Bear made a truly jaw-dropping prediction about the LIV golfer. “Well, let’s start off what he could do, “ Nicklaus began. “He could drive the 1st green. If it’s firm, he could drive the 1st green. Under the right conditions. “ It’s worth pointing out here that the first hole at Augusta National is 455 yards, and it is uphill! Now, players can slightly cut the corner on the first hole, and by doing so, shorten the hole by perhaps 40 yards. Still, in order for Bryson DeChambeau to drive the green on the first hole at Augusta National, he would need a wind bordering on a gale at his back. While DeChambeau is the longest hitter in the game, he will almost certainly never drive the green on the opening hole at The Masters. Nicklaus’ prediction about the two-time US Open winner has to go down as one of his poorer ones throughout the years.

item.title: Novak Djokovic’s ATP Finals chances handed huge blow as the Paris Masters draw is revealed
item.description: Novak Djokovic suffered a shock early exit from the Basel Open this week, and in the process suffered a huge blow to his chances of qualifying for the ATP Finals. The only consolation was that Rafael Jodar, his biggest competitor for that final spot, also lost. The fight was still on. However, that still hinged massively on the 39-year-old putting together a strong run of form through two consecutive events, one of which he had not played at in 15 years. Now, Novak Djokovic needs to achieve something exceptional in the French capital to even stand a chance. Unfortunately for him, luck has once again not been on his side. Novak Djokovic’s nightmare Paris Masters draw As if things could get no harder for Djokovic, he will be forced to kickstart his campaign in Paris against the dangerously in-form Valentin Vacherot. Last year’s Shanghai Masters champion is coming off the back of a semi-final run in Japan, and will play Taylor Fritz tomorrow for a spot in the Basel Open final. Clearly, on indoor courts, the Monegasque player is a threat. If Djokovic can bypass Vacherot, he will be afforded some reprieve in the second round, facing either Luciano Darderi or a qualifier. However, this is when the gauntlet really starts. One of Alex de Minaur or Andrey Rublev should await in the third round, before Alexander Zverev, the top seed and newly-crowned world number one, stands out in his quarter. To beat the German would take an almighty feat, though he did manage it just a few weeks ago. Sadly, Ben Shelton, Frances Tiafoe or Tommy Paul all could be his semi-final opponents. Finalists could range from Carlos Alcaraz to Daniil Medvedev, or even Arthur Fils. It is a truly nightmarish run. How can Novak Djokovic qualify for the ATP Finals now? With his performances in Basel, Medvedev has already secured his spot at the ATP Finals . That leaves just four remaining. The bare minimum Djokovic needs to stay in contention is a semi-final, but that only works if rivals like De Minaur and Fritz gain no more points this week and lose their Paris openers. Winning would take the 39-year-old to 3,890 and past Jodar, which should secure his place. However, if De Minaur wins Vienna this week and then reaches the Paris final, he’d reach 3,930 and narrowly edge out even a title-winning Djokovic. His only last-minute course of action would then be to enter the ATP 250 event in Stockholm.

item.description: Porro, Gallagher And Solanke To Start | 4-2-3-1 Tottenham Hotspur Predicted Lineup Vs Crystal Palace Tottenham Hotspur will entertain Crystal Palace at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium this Saturday evening as they look to secure all three points at home in the London derby. Spurs managed to secure a solid 2-0 win away at Chelsea recently, which should give them a ton of confidence going into this game. Roberto De Zerbi will set his men up in a 4-2-3-1 formation and is expected to make a few changes to his first team for this clash. Pedro Porro, Conor Gallagher and Dominic Solanke could all play from the start of this game. 4-2-3-1 Tottenham Hotspur Predicted Lineup To Face Crystal Palace Defence Antonin Kinsky will feature in between the sticks for Tottenham after keeping a clean sheet in his last appearance. Micky van de Ven will operate alongside Jan Paul van Hecke at the centre of De Zerbi’s defence as they look to keep a good shape on the defensive end of the field. Pedro Porro will try to catch the eye as the right-back, while Andy Robertson looks to give a good account of himself on the other side as the left-back. Both of them will get the license to go forward and express themselves inside the Palace half. Ben Davies will offer cover for the defensive positions on the bench. LONDON, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 25: Conor Gallagher of Tottenham Hotspur in action during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Chelsea FC and Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on October 25, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Mike Hewitt/Getty Images) Midfield Mateus Fernandes and Sandro Tonali will anchor the midfield for the North London club as they look to win the 50-50 battles at the centre of the park and engineer some decent chances in the final third. The gifted trio of Mathys Tel, Conor Gallagher and Mohammed Kudus will operate just ahead of them as part of De Zerbi’s attack. All three of them need to link up play well inside the opponent’s half if they want to engineer some decent chances in the final third. James Maddison is a major doubt for this game. However, Dejan Kulusevski will be available for selection on the bench and might come on to influence the game in the latter stages if required. Attack Dominic Solanke will spearhead Tottenham ‘s attack up top. He would be eager to make a difference for Spurs by finding the back of the net in the London derby this weekend. Omar Marmoush will have to be content with a spot on the bench as he waits for his chance to shine in the second 45 minutes if needed.

item.title: Hansi Flick agrees with Barcelona star Rodri’s post-Real Madrid defeat assessment
item.description: Hansi Flick agrees with Barcelona star Rodri’s post-Real Madrid defeat assessment Barcelona head coach Hansi Flick has admitted that he is in agreement with midfield star Rodri, regarding the needs of the Blaugrana’s squad when in difficult situations on the pitch. Barcelona are of course fresh off an altogether disappointing last week on the results front. After rattling off 11 consecutive victories to open the campaign, the Blaugrana were condemned to back-to-back defeats at the hands of Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid. The latter proved to be particularly concerning, as Los Blancos, for lengthy stretches at the Camp Nou, looked in full control of proceedings. Speaking to the media post-match, Barcelona summer signing Rodri was therefore quick to send some advice the way of his new teammates, urging for more ‘calmness’ when in pressure moments. And drawn on the comments of his engine room general during his latest appearance in front of the media on Friday, Hansi Flick was in full agreement: “Rodri is right, sometimes we need to play with a bit more calmness.” Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Fabrizio Romano confirmation sets scene for Liverpool, timeline to sign genius player
item.description: Fabrizio Romano confirmation sets scene for Liverpool, timeline to sign genius player Fabrizio Romano has laid out the timeline and now Liverpool know what they've got to do. A truly genius player will be on the market. Liverpool have made a habit of signing the best-possible talents in world football over the last couple of summers. That thinking has seen them spend over nine figures on three different players, having never come particularly close to spending that before. But it's the new strategy. Sign the best players available and then find a way to build a functioning team out of them. While that last bit has been a struggle up to now, there's a lot of faith in Andoni Iraola to figure it all out. It also means that Liverpool will once again look for a big name in 2027. We do expect major signings in midfield and at centre-back but that doesn't mean the attack is completely sorted. In fact, there is room for another big arrival next year, especially after the Reds tried to sell Cody Gakpo at the end of the transfer window. Couple that with a need for some sort of left-footed attacker and we think the chance is there for arguably the most exciting signing of all. Nico Paz up for grabs Fabrizio Romano has confirmed that Nico Paz will not move in January. Instead, it's expected that there will be a battle for his signature next summer when Real Madrid have a buyback clause. This is the second buyback clause they've had for Paz. The first was activated last summer, only for Los Blancos to immediately sell him back to Como with an increased one. Como, then, know they can't control his future beyond next summer. They have no intention of changing that and will refuse any January offers on account of his form this season and importance to the team. Paz is quite clearly one of the biggest prospects in football right now. He was outstanding last season and looks improved in this campaign - a genuinely sensational talent who can seemingly do it all. We've written recently about just how good Paz is and just how much of an impact he could have on Liverpool's attack. He's the kind of player that everyone should try to sign. It's exactly the situation that the Reds current strategy calls for, in fact. One in which you sign the best available player and then look to make it work. Paz is exactly that: the best player available. With the caveat that Real Madrid could ultimately look to integrate him. We feel that's a little unlikely given the wealth of attacking midfield options they already boast - it would be difficult to guarantee him a starting XI role from the get go. Liverpool could. And should.

item.title: "It Always Takes Time to Compete Again" - Enzo Maresca Makes Manchester City Silverware Prediction After Pep Guardiola Exit
item.description: "It Always Takes Time to Compete Again" - Enzo Maresca Makes Manchester City Silverware Prediction After Pep Guardiola Exit Enzo Maresca received heavy backing from Hugo Viana and co in the transfer market upon Pep Guardiola's exit. It is exactly four months since the Italian succeeded Pep Guardiola in the north-west and in doing so, signed up for perhaps the hardest job in world football. Guardiola won 20 major trophies across his decade stationed at the Etihad Stadium, including six Premier League titles, three FA Cup triumphs and an unprecedented Treble in 2023 - the first by an English club since Manchester United in 1999. And while Maresca was part of the Treble-winning year - as Guardiola’s assistant - this job produced an incomparable workload in contrast to his previous roles at Leicester City and Chelsea . Maintaining high standards at the club hasn’t been a difficult task for Maresca, and it seems the 46-year-old has brought an invaluable ability to increase squad cohesion and find a togetherness that is very much overlooked. Manchester City went on an eight-game win streak before losing to Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League, where back-to-back wins after that defeat preceded a more recent descent again. Last weekend, City were beaten by Aston Villa away from home and although they won in the Carabao Cup against Saturday’s opponents on Wednesday on penalties, Brighton and Hove Albion looked the better side and should have taken something from the game. Speaking ahead of his side’s second meeting with Brighton in four days, Maresca said: “We’re going in the right direction. After so many years, to change the manager, many players, it always takes time to compete again. On whether his Manchester City side are competing at the moment, he added: “I think, at the moment, we are competing, and we changed many players and changed manager. “But the good thing about the club is that I think we are competing in all competitions, and we know that it takes time, but at this moment we continue in the same way.” A positive start to the season under Maresca - but are errors threatening a total collapse? It has been an incredibly encouraging start to the season for Manchester City , particularly in huge early-season tests against the likes of United, Liverpool and PSG. Even in defeat against Luis Enrique’s side, there were a handful of positives to pick from a much-improved second-half performance, alongside obvious and avoidable mishaps that can be worked on in training. Another example of that came against Villa, where Marc Guehi and Gianluigi Donnarumma both had games to forget after making mistakes that played into their opponent's hands. The latter was dropped for the Carabao Cup win over Brighton, but is likely to return to the starting squad this weekend as part of several changes across the pitch. item.title: Knueppel’s G League Move Signals Hornets Return Is Close
item.description: Mike Watters-Imagn Images The Charlotte Hornets finally have a clear sign that Kon Knueppel is ready to play. The team sent the forward to the Greensboro Swarm for a practice session on Thursday. This move means the 21-year-old is getting his legs back under him after missing the first five games. He was injured during offseason work, and fans have been waiting to see him shoot in a real game. The team confirmed the assignment in a post on X, stating, “OFFICIAL: @hornets have assigned forward Kon Knueppel to the @greensboroswarm for today’s practice.” It is a huge step forward for a player who led the league in three-pointers last year. The Path Back From Injury Knueppel missed the entire preseason and the start of this season due to a strained left hamstring. He suffered the injury just over a month ago. Now, he is using the G League to build up his stamina without the pressure of a full NBA game. These assignments are standard for players recovering from soft tissue issues. Basketnews.com wrote on the team’s decision, “This move is part of his rehabilitation process. Assignments to a G League affiliate for practice are commonly used to give recovering players additional on-court work.” The Hornets need his scoring punch badly. Brandon Miller is averaging 25.6 points per game, but he cannot carry the load alone forever. No Date Set Yet The team has not set a specific date for his return. Head coach Charles Lee spoke at a press conference and admitted they still do not have a plan. “No timeline, as far as I know right now,” the Hornets coach said. He added, “I hope that during this road trip, or after the road trip, we’ll get a little bit more information.” The team is playing the Washington Wizards on Friday and the Philadelphia 76ers on Saturday. Lee might wait until after this trip to make a call. Some reports from ESPN’s injury report suggest a return date of November 2, but that is just a guess until the coach confirms it. The Hornets need Knueppel to help them compete in the Eastern Conference. Last season, he finished second in Rookie of the Year voting after averaging 18.5 points. Without him, the team has won three of five games despite losing to the Pistons on Wednesday. The loss to Detroit showed how much the team struggles without their top shooter. Naz Reid was benched for not meeting standards, and the offense stalled. The team traded LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges, so they need the young talent to step up. If he practices well on Thursday, he could be ready for the Pistons game on Monday.

item.title: ¡MALAGÓN MANDA MENSAJE TRAS LA MALA RACHA EN EL AZTECA!
item.description: ¡MALAGÓN MANDA MENSAJE TRAS LA MALA RACHA EN EL AZTECA! El guardameta del América reconoció que el equipo atraviesa una racha de cinco partidos sin ganar; sin embargo, aseguró que el grupo mantiene la tranquilidad El Club América atraviesa un momento en el que los resultados no han acompañado al equipo como esperaba su afición. Son cinco partidos sin conocer la victoria, una situación que representa un desafío para una institución acostumbrada a competir por los primeros lugares. Sin embargo, dentro del vestidor azulcrema mantienen la confianza en que el panorama puede cambiar. Durante la conferencia de prensa previa al encuentro frente a Toluca, Luis Ángel Malagón habló sobre la actualidad del conjunto americanista y dejó claro que, pese a la racha negativa, el equipo no pierde de vista sus objetivos. “Son cinco partidos de no ganar, pero todo es parte de… al final seguimos en la parte alta y mañana será un rival más”, expresó el arquero azulcrema. CONFIANZA TOTAL EN AMÉRICA Las palabras de Malagón reflejan la postura de un equipo que busca mantener la calma en medio de la exigencia que representa defender los colores del América. El guardameta reconoció implícitamente que los resultados recientes no han sido los esperados, pero también puso sobre la mesa un aspecto importante: el conjunto continúa ubicado en la parte alta de la clasificación. Te recomiendo AMÉRICA DEJA ESCAPAR EL TRIUNFO ANTE XOLOS El compromiso ante Toluca representa una nueva oportunidad para que las Águilas puedan reencontrarse con la victoria y comenzar a dejar atrás esta racha. No será un encuentro sencillo, pues enfrente tendrán a un rival que también llega con aspiraciones importantes dentro del campeonato. Para Malagón, el mensaje es claro: mantener la tranquilidad, trabajar y afrontar cada partido con la responsabilidad que exige representar al americanismo.

item.title: India launches next-gen navigation satellite to orbit (video)
item.description: null India bolstered its homegrown satellite-navigation system today (Oct. 30). A GSLV Mark II rocket launched the nation's NVS-03 satellite from Satish Dhawan Space Centre today at 2:21 p.m. EDT (1821 GMT and 11:51 p.m. India Standard Time). Everything went well: The rocket deployed NVS-03 into geostationary transfer orbit as planned, officials with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) announced on X about 30 minutes after liftoff. An Indian GSLV Mark II rocket launches the NVS-03 navigation satellite on Oct. 30, 2026. (Image credit: ISRO) NVS-03 is the third next-gen satellite that India has launched for the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC), its version of the United States' Global Positioning System ( GPS ). NavIC operates on a smaller scale than its American counterpart, however. It's "a regional navigation satellite system designed to provide accurate Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) service to users in India as well as the region extending about 1,500 km [930 miles] beyond the Indian landmass, which is its primary service area," ISRO officials wrote in the NVS-03 launch brochure . The Indian constellation currently consists of three fully functioning satellites, and it requires four to provide PNT services. So today's launch was a big deal — and a lot of eyes will be watching NVS-03's commissioning and checkout phase. Today's launch was the 14th to date for the GSLV (Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle) Mark II, a three-stage rocket that stands 170 feet (52 meters) tall. Twelve of those 14 liftoffs have been successful. The GSLV Mark II debuted in 2010, the same year its predecessor retired. That previous launchers, the Mark I, flew a total of six times, with two failures. NVS-03 was the fourth Indian launch of 2026 and the third operated by ISRO. The fourth was mounted by Skyroot Aerospace, which in July became the first Indian company ever to successfully reach orbit .

item.title: Chad Kelly’s Historic CFL Deal Proves NFL Wrong
item.description: Nov 9, 2024; Montreal, Quebec, CAN; Toronto Argonauts quarterback Chad Kelly (12) passes the ball against the Montreal Alouettes during the first quarter at Percival-Molson Memorial Stadium. Mandatory Credit: David Kirouac-Imagn Images His new contract makes Chad Kelly the first million-dollar player in the league’s salary cap era. The NFL passed on him, but the CFL is now paying him like a franchise cornerstone. According to multiple reports, including figures cited by the New York Post , the deal could reach $5,805,250, including bonuses. That is real money for a man the NFL labeled Mr. Irrelevant. The numbers tell the story of a player who found his footing after being discarded. Before this extension, BC Lions quarterback Nathan Rourke held the title of highest-paid player with a salary of $684,700. Kelly’s new deal dwarfs that figure and changes the economic landscape for every quarterback in Canada. He posted career highs this season with 5,067 passing yards and 33 touchdowns. Those stats are not just good; they are elite by any standard. A Home in Toronto Kelly did not just sign a check; he found a place to stay. During a press conference on Tuesday, he said coming to the CFL “was the best decision I ever made in my life.” He added that he has a beautiful family and has “come to love Canada on a whole other level.” He stated that he “never knew I could come to love a place so much (more) than my home and now this is my home forever,” and that he is “just thankful to be in this situation.” This sentiment matters because it shows he is not just passing through. He helped the Argonauts win the Grey Cup in 2022 and has been a key part of their offense since. The NFL treated him as a bust after taking him last overall in the 2017 draft. He never found his footing there. Now he is the face of the league in Canada with a contract that secures his future. The Cost of Being Mr. Irrelevant The NFL draft is a cruel machine that often throws away talent . Kelly was the last pick in 2017. He is the nephew of Buffalo Bills great Jim Kelly, which makes the NFL’s rejection even more striking. He spent years bouncing around before finding success in the CFL. The league that ignored him is now watching from the sidelines while he signs a historic extension. Although the Argonauts did not release financial terms after the official announcement, the reported figures are clear. This deal proves that a player can rebuild a career if given the chance. Kelly set new records this year, and the team rewarded him accordingly. The gap between his NFL draft status and his current value is massive. He is no longer a question mark. He is the highest-paid player in the league and a proven winner. The NFL missed out on a quarterback who can throw for over 5,000 yards and lead a team to a championship. That is a mistake the league will have to live with. Kelly is settled in Toronto and ready to play for years to come.

item.title: Cyberbullying : Okafor’s lawyer faults Sowore, others over sentimental support for Ogala
item.description: By Henry Ojelu Counsel to Pastor Chris Okafor, Mr Ife Ajayi, has faulted the sentimental support for Nollywood actress Doris Ogala over her cyberbullying trial, insisting that freedom of expression does not confer the right to make false and malicious allegations against others without regard for the law. Ajayi, who spoke in an interview with Vanguard, was reacting to comments by activist Omoyele Sowore and Ogala over alleged injustice in the ongoing trial. He argued that the right to freedom of expression was not absolute and must be exercised within the limits prescribed by law, particularly where allegations, blackmail and extortion were involved. According to him, the issues leading to the criminal proceedings should not be treated as a mere disagreement between individuals, but viewed against the background of alleged violations of the rights of others. Ajayi advised the public to obtain copies of the charges proffered against her. He described her unlawful conduct as a deliberate act that violated the rights of his client and was capable of inciting the public against an individual. He also urged members of the public to exercise caution in endorsing false allegations made by the actress, insisting that such claims should be subjected to legal scrutiny rather than public sentiment. Expressing confidence in the judiciary, the lawyer said he was optimistic that the court would deliver justice based on the overwhelming print, audio and video evidence in compliance with the applicable laws. “I am 100 per cent optimistic that the court will do what is right. The court, in all fairness, even after the defendant’s lawyer pleaded with it to release her on bail and offered to take responsibility for her conduct, gave the prosecution 48 hours to respond,” he said. Ajayi also faulted Ogala’s conduct during the court proceedings, alleging that her outburst and disruption of proceedings raised questions about her ability to abide by the conditions of her release. He said the incident suggested that even her counsel might have difficulty guaranteeing her conduct if she were granted bail. The lawyer maintained that the courtroom was not a place for emotional outbursts or disrespect, stressing that parties to a legal proceeding were expected to conduct themselves in accordance with established rules. “You cannot behave disrespectfully at a police station or anywhere else and expect to do the same in a court of law. The court is where logic and legal accountability prevail,” he said. Ajayi further called on the National Assembly to consider stricter legislation against the practice of publicly calling out individuals over private disagreements, particularly where such actions could damage reputations or violate the rights of others. He argued that personal grievances should be addressed through appropriate legal channels rather than through public accusations and campaigns. “The law is not about emotion or sentiment. item.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
item.description: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable . With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal is proposed by Kevin Kelley, a technical lead for standards at Anthropic, as part of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). It will live within a website's robots.txt file , which has long signaled which web crawlers can and can't scrape a site - whether for search indexing, archiving, or … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: ‎NSITF seeks stronger enforcement of Employees’ Compensation Act to protect workers’ rights
item.description: ‎ ‎By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ‎ ‎ABUJA — MANAGING Director and Chief Executive of the Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund (NSITF), Mr. Oluwaseun Faleye, has urged the judiciary to strengthen the interpretation, adjudication, and enforcement of the Employees’ Compensation Act (ECA) 2010, so that Nigerian workers can fully enjoy the justice and protection the law guarantees. ‎ ‎The Act provides compensation for employees—or their dependants—who suffer death, injury, disability, or occupational disease arising from employment. ‎ ‎Faleye, in his welcome address at the opening of the NSITF 2026 Legal Stakeholders’ Engagement in Abuja, ‎emphasised that legislation alone is not enough; workers need timely dispute resolution, fair hearings, and effective compliance with court orders to turn statutory rights into real benefits. ‎The theme of the two-day event is “Enhancing Judicial Interpretation, Adjudication and Enforcement under the Employees’ Compensation Act (ECA), 2010.” ‎ ‎Mr. Faleye noted that while last year’s engagement focused on strengthening collaboration for the sustainable administration of the Employees’ Compensation Scheme, this year’s edition addresses a deeper question: how statutory rights can be translated into practical justice. ‎ ‎Drawing on the experience of everyday Nigerian workers — mothers, construction workers, factory employees and drivers who leave home each day expecting to return he observed that a workplace accident instantly becomes a human crisis with financial, emotional and social consequences. ‎ ‎”Does the law provide a framework for protection? Yes. Does the Employees’ Compensation Act establish a system for compensation for work-related injury, disease, disability or death? Yes. But the existence of a law does not by itself guarantee that its promise will be fulfilled,” Mr. Faleye said. ‎ ‎He explained that the effectiveness of the ECA depends on three interconnected stages — interpretation, adjudication and enforcement: ‎”First, are the provisions being understood and applied in a manner consistent with their wording, purpose and legal context? ‎ ‎”Second, are disputes being resolved fairly, on evidence and applicable law, without avoidable delay? Third, are lawful decisions and orders being given effect so that justice does not end with the pronouncement of judgment? Weakness at any stage can undermine confidence in the entire system.” ‎ ‎The NSITF Managing Director underscored the pivotal role of the National Industrial Court of Nigeria (NICN) in labour justice, noting that the Court’s interpretation of the Employees’ Compensation Act has consequences beyond the immediate parties to a dispute. ‎ ‎Such decisions, he said, clarify rights, guide the conduct of employers and employees, and shape the resolution of future disputes. ‎ ‎For workers, he said, justice means the practical realisation of their entitlements; for employers, it means a predictable legal environment.
